		original_tag = SOY
	}
	enable = {
		OR = {
			mk_absurd_high = yes
			has_idea = mk_idea_revisionist
			has_global_flag = mk_era_crises_fired
		}
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes

	ai_strategy = {
		type = antagonize
		id = VCI
		value = 40
	}
	ai_strategy = {
		type = antagonize
		id = BTR
		value = 40
	}
}

SOY_hunt_VCI = {
	allowed = {
		original_tag = SOY
	}
	enable = {
		is_in_faction = yes
		VCI = {
			has_idea = mk_idea_revisionist
		}
	}
	abort_when_not_enabled = yes

	ai_strategy = {
		type = antagonize
		id = VCI
		value = 300
	}
	ai_strategy = {
		type = conquer
		id = VCI
		value = 150
	}
	ai_strategy = {
		type = contain
		id = VCI
		value = 100
	}
}
